name: Vesopa Go
subtitle: Orders & payments, anywhere
promotional_text: Seat a table, send the order to the kitchen and take the payment, all from your phone, with everything in the same Vesopa back office as your tills.
description:
Vesopa Go puts your Vesopa EPOS till in your pocket. Take orders and payments anywhere in the venue, at the counter, at the table or out on the terrace, and everything lands in the same back office as your tills.

At the table
• See the floor plan live: which tables are seated, ordering, waiting or paying
• Seat a table, add covers and order from the venue's real menu, with modifiers, choices and allergens
• Send to the kitchen in one tap; courses are fired when you say
• Open bills are shared with the tills: start a bill on the phone, finish it at the bar, or the other way round

At the counter
• A quick, clear sell screen for bars, cafés, pop-ups and events
• Quick sale for a typed amount
• Cash with change shown, or card

Card payments with Dojo
• On a Dojo Pocket, the card is read by Dojo's own app on the device
• On an iPhone, Tap to Pay on iPhone through Dojo, where enabled for your venue
• Or send the payment to the venue's Dojo card machine
• Refunds need a manager's PIN, every time

Live and fast
• A live connection to the back office: orders, bills, the kitchen and menu changes arrive the moment they happen
• Keeps working through a dropped signal and sends the sales when it is back

Sales and reports
• Today's receipts, emailed receipts and refunds
• The day's takings by payment type and category, and End of day

Secure sign-in
• Sign in with your venue's Vesopa account (Vesopa Auth), then staff use their own PIN, staff card or fingerprint

Vesopa Go is for venues that use Vesopa EPOS, and is added to a venue's licences by Vesopa. Ask us for a look at info@vesopasoftware.com.

review.notes: Vesopa Go is the phone and tablet app for venues that use Vesopa EPOS: orders at the table and the counter, sent to the kitchen, paid by card or cash, with every sale in the venue's Vesopa back office. To review it, tap Continue with Vesopa and sign in with the account in Sign-in information above: The Vesopa Kitchen, Vesopa's own test venue, whose card payments run on Dojo's sandbox, so no real money moves. Then sign on with the staff PIN given here. Card payments in a real venue are taken by Dojo (Tap to Pay on iPhone, or the venue's Dojo card machine); the app never reads card data.
